newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish debt/currency market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swedish debt/currency market closing report.

text.p: Swedish debt yields fell a touch on Thursday, mainly on the shorter end where hopes for further Riksbank rate cuts fuelled gains.
Stronger foreign markets lent support in the afternoon on the long end, dealers said.
The crown strengthened against the mark along with a firmer dollar in the early session, but lost ground in the afternoon.
"The crown was strongest when the dollar broke through the 1.53 level against the mark. Then the crown did not manage to keep up any longer," a dealer said.
The crown traded between 4.36 and 4.3770 during the day.
At session close the crown stood at 4.3740 against the mark compared to 4.3690 late on Wednesday. The crown was 6.7031 versus the dollar compared to 6.6495.
Six-month T-bill rates fell one basis point to 4.26 percent and the ten-year bond yield slid two basis points to 7.09 percent.
